limitations: Public tuning on a static, monochromatic, exactly matched six-mode simulated plant; the twelve independent bases define the sampling extent.
Loss averages replicates within member, members within base, bases within stratum, strata within cell, then cells equally. Singleton bases and conjugate pairs have equal base weight.
One global setting per family minimizes the unrounded tuning loss; exact ties use ascending candidate ID. Singleton families are fixed controls, not searches over alternative settings.
These selection-conditioned tuning losses are not held-out performance, population, generalization, significance, equivalence, model-mismatch or language-model evaluation evidence.

Verification checks complete inventory, source/configuration bindings, saved-estimate policy replay, fit-prefix schedules, detector draws, camera-score fallback and evaluator state. It does not rerun optimization, establish optimality or authenticate archive authorship.
Exclusion checks cover the explicit fixture registry and four declared prior cohorts totaling 4,132 bases before deduplication, not all possible prior exposures.

Budgets are correlated, separately charged episodes. At fixed photons per exposure, larger budgets spend more expected photons. Coordinate search completes its first six-mode sweep at 13 exposures; smaller budgets are partial searches and step halving is inactive.
A numerical fit failure marks its episode policy_failure even if a later fit recovers. Its finite camera-score fallback stays in loss. Finite nonconvergence alone is not policy_failure.

decision_seconds sums command decisions and final submission. It excludes camera simulation, file publication, preparation, verification, pauses and most management overhead; it is not acquisition wall time or a real-time guarantee. Fit durations are already included, not added again.

The solver allows three starts and at most 200 iterations per start; equal measurement budgets and candidate counts do not imply equal computation. This summary does not independently reproduce optimizer diagnostics; affected-episode paths identify retained records for inspection.
Unmeasured final corrections must not be presented as measured corrected camera images.
